Tables of a track model

Source: R/TRACK.R
track_fixes.Rd

track_fixes() and track_tracks() return the stored tables of a TRACK(). track_segments() derives the segments: one row per pair of consecutive fixes within a track, keyed by .seg, with the two fix keys (.fix0, .fix1), their coordinates and date-times, and the duration dt in seconds.

track_fixes(x, ...)

track_tracks(x, ...)

track_segments(x, ...)

Arguments

x

a track model, or anything as_track() accepts

...

unused

Value

A data frame.

Examples

tr <- as_track(trips0)
head(track_fixes(tr))
#>   .fix .track                date        x         y
#> 1    0      0 2001-01-01 15:39:50 115.2767 -42.37580
#> 2    1      0 2001-01-01 18:16:52 116.1539 -41.41227
#> 3    2      0 2001-01-01 21:03:38 115.9701 -41.13299
#> 4    3      0 2001-01-01 22:09:41 116.5146 -42.13881
#> 5    4      0 2001-01-01 23:33:54 116.4558 -41.86720
#> 6    5      0 2001-01-02 01:25:12 117.6208 -41.99047
track_tracks(tr)
#>   .track id
#> 1      0  1
#> 2      1  2
#> 3      2  3
head(track_segments(tr))
#>   .seg .track .fix0 .fix1       x0        y0       x1        y1
#> 1    0      0     0     1 115.2767 -42.37580 116.1539 -41.41227
#> 2    1      0     1     2 116.1539 -41.41227 115.9701 -41.13299
#> 3    2      0     2     3 115.9701 -41.13299 116.5146 -42.13881
#> 4    3      0     3     4 116.5146 -42.13881 116.4558 -41.86720
#> 5    4      0     4     5 116.4558 -41.86720 117.6208 -41.99047
#> 6    5      0     5     6 117.6208 -41.99047 117.0481 -41.70748
#>                 date0               date1    dt
#> 1 2001-01-01 15:39:50 2001-01-01 18:16:52  9422
#> 2 2001-01-01 18:16:52 2001-01-01 21:03:38 10006
#> 3 2001-01-01 21:03:38 2001-01-01 22:09:41  3963
#> 4 2001-01-01 22:09:41 2001-01-01 23:33:54  5053
#> 5 2001-01-01 23:33:54 2001-01-02 01:25:12  6678
#> 6 2001-01-02 01:25:12 2001-01-02 06:45:40 19228
